title: Compliance Bulletin: Out-of-State Filing Charge on Owner Auto Policy Reinstatements with Lapse
content:
**Charge.** On a reinstatement with lapse of an Owner Auto Policy term, an out-of-state filing charge is added to the reinstatement fee. It compares the filing state of the certificate backed by the term with the term's garaging state. The certificate is a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) filing, read as it stood on the reinstatement effective date, and selected as follows:
- the certificate entered first with status filed, when its filed date is on or before the reinstatement effective date;
- otherwise, the certificate entered first with status cancellation filed, when its filed date is on or before that date.

A certificate filed after the reinstatement effective date does not change the reading.

| Filing state of that certificate | Charge added |
|---|---|
| Differs from the garaging state, and is Florida or Virginia (where FR-44 certificates are also filed) | 10.00 |
| Differs from the garaging state, and is any other state | 5.00 |
| Equal to the garaging state | nothing |
| No such certificate | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Garaging state | Filing state | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Georgia | Florida | 10.00 |
| Florida | Georgia | 5.00 |
| Texas | Texas | nothing |
